- [research/recovered/knowledge_history1/reports/knowledge/REF_AUDIO_VORBIS.md:125](../../research/recovered/knowledge_history1/reports/knowledge/REF_AUDIO_VORBIS.md?plain=1#L125-L125) — - ID `REA-LOCAL-20261031-18H-P0-VORBIS-BITBUFFER-TEARDOWN-NULL-SLOT-STATIC-01`; source `rea_lab/decomp_task/REA_20261031_18H_P0_VORBIS_BITBUFFER_TEARDOWN_STATIC.md`. `0x5D4A60` checks the outer+0x68 parent pointer, then iterates 15 slots calling `0x5E6CA0` from `0x5D4A93`. The slot-destructor first reads `[slot+8]` before checking the **inner buffer** pointer; there is no local guard for a NULL slot itself. For index 7 the caller skips the separate slot free because the slot is embedded, while the inner buffer cleanup still executes; other fourteen slot objects are freed, then parent and outer are cleared. A parent with a NULL slot would be unsafe at the static read, but its creation and a teardown call after partial allocation are unverified. Five independently matching PE windows and owner audit 66/66; **no measured game fault**.
